tests.title: Optional-match predicate stays optional
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(q) WHERE q.age > 100 RETURN p.name,q.name

tests.title: UNION removes duplicates
tests.query: RETURN 'x' AS v UNION RETURN 'x' AS v

tests.title: UNION ALL preserves duplicates
tests.query: RETURN 'x' AS v UNION ALL RETURN 'x' AS v

tests.title: WITH projection and filter
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person) WITH p.name AS name,p.age AS age WHERE age>25 RETURN name

tests.title: UNWIND empty list produces zero rows
UNWIND null produces zero rows
tests.query: UNWIND null AS x RETURN x

tests.title: Correlated EXISTS subquery
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->() } RETURN p.name

tests.title: CALL subquery
tests.query: CALL { RETURN 7 AS x } RETURN x

tests.title: Correlated CALL subquery
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'}) CALL { WITH p MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(q) RETURN q.name AS name } RETURN name

tests.title: COLLECT subquery
tests.query: RETURN COLLECT { MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.name }

tests.title: ORDER BY multiple keys
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.age DESC,p.name

tests.title: SKIP and LIMIT
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.name SKIP 1 LIMIT 2

tests.title: nodes(path)
tests.query: MATCH p=(:Person {name:'Alice'})-[:KNOWS]->(:Person {name:'Bob'}) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.name]

tests.title: relationships(path)
tests.query: MATCH p=(:Person {name:'Alice'})-[:KNOWS]->(:Person {name:'Bob'}) RETURN [r IN relationships(p) | r.weight]

tests.title: collect ignores null
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person) WITH p ORDER BY p.age RETURN collect(p.age)

tests.title: Filter after aggregation
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(q) WITH p.name AS name,count(q) AS n WHERE n>1 RETURN name

tests.title: Three-valued boolean logic
tests.query: RETURN null AND false,null OR true,NOT null

tests.title: Searched CASE
tests.query: RETURN CASE WHEN 2>1 THEN 7 ELSE 0 END

tests.title: Simple CASE
tests.query: RETURN CASE 2 WHEN 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END

tests.title: IS NULL predicate
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age IS NULL RETURN p.name

tests.title: Map projection
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'}) WITH p{.name,.age} AS m RETURN m.name,m.age

tests.title: REMOVE property
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person {uid:1}) SET p.score=7 REMOVE p.score RETURN p.score

tests.title: FOREACH mutation
tests.query: MATCH (p:Person {uid:1}) FOREACH (x IN [1,2] | SET p.score=x) RETURN p.score

tests.title: DELETE isolated node
tests.query: CREATE (p:Probe {name:'gone'}) WITH p DELETE p RETURN 1

tests.title: SELECT mapped property
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . }

tests.title: FILTER numeric comparison
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name ; ex:age ?age . FILTER(?age>25) }

tests.title: Join triple patterns
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name "Alice" ; ex:knows ?q . ?q ex:name ?name . }

tests.title: OPTIONAL unbound value
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name ?age WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . OPTIONAL { ?p ex:age ?age . } FILTER(?name="Dave") }

tests.title: DISTINCT projection
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT DISTINCT ?name WHERE { ?p ex:knows ?q . ?q ex:name ?name . }

tests.title: UNION solution multiplicity
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?x WHERE { { BIND(1 AS ?x) } UNION { BIND(1 AS ?x) } }

tests.title: BIND expression
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?x WHERE { BIND(1+2 AS ?x) }

tests.title: COUNT aggregate
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a ex:Person . }

tests.title: SUM aggregate
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT (SUM(?age) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:age ?age . }

tests.title: ASK boolean
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> ASK WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name "Alice" . }

tests.title: FILTER NOT EXISTS
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?p ex:knows ?q . } }

tests.title: BOUND on optional variable
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . OPTIONAL { ?p ex:age ?age . } FILTER(!BOUND(?age)) }

tests.title: MINUS with shared binding
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . MINUS { ?p ex:age 30 . } }

tests.title: STR lexical form
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?s WHERE { BIND(STR(ex:Alice) AS ?s) }

tests.title: REGEX string filter
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . FILTER(REGEX(?name,"^A")) }

tests.title: ORDER BY and LIMIT
tests.query: PREFIX ex: <https://example.com/> SELECT ?name WHERE { ?p a ex:Person ; ex:name ?name . } ORDER BY ?name LIMIT 2
